name: Timeline
hint: Turn on Sample content and press Advance: the line draws to the next step before that step lights up.
description: Vertical or horizontal steps for order tracking, onboarding or a wizard header, from your own steps (title, description, time, status, icon). Progress is choreographed: advancing draws the connecting line first, and only when it arrives does the next node light up and the finished one draw its check; going back unwinds it. The current step pulses three times and then rests, an error step shows a warning glyph, and narrow horizontal layouts keep only the current label. It is an ordered list with the current step marked aria-current="step"; steps become buttons only when you pass onStepClick.
usage: Use to show where something is in a fixed sequence of three to seven steps. Pass `steps` ([{ id, title, description, time, status, icon }]) and either `current` (the index of the current step; earlier steps are done) or a `status` on each step (done / current / upcoming / error). Add `onStepClick(step, index)` to let people go back to finished steps, `label` for the list's accessible name, and `loading` / `error` while the steps load. For open-ended histories use Activity Feed instead.

dataProps.description: [{ id, title, description, time, status, icon, clickable, disabled }]. description is a node (text is accepted as its old name); status is done | current | upcoming | error; icon is a node or kit icon name shown in the node.
Same as steps, under the other common name.
Index of the current step (0-based): steps before it are done, steps after it upcoming; steps.length means all done. Ignored when any step has its own status.
Vertical shows descriptions; horizontal is a wizard header and keeps only the current label when narrow.
(step, index, event) => void. Makes actionable steps buttons: done, current and error steps, or any step with clickable: true; never a step with disabled: true.
(step, { index, status }) => node. Replaces the title / time / description block; the node, line, list semantics and status word stay.
Accessible name of the ordered list.
Badge beside the current step's title (vertical). Empty hides it.
Screen-reader words per status, merged over { done: "Completed", current: "In progress", upcoming: "Not started", error: "Failed" }.
Dashed track between steps.
Show each step's time.
Dimmed, and no step is clickable.
Three placeholder steps while you load.
Shown when there are no steps.
Could not load: this message in place of the list (true shows a default).
Adds a retry button to the error message.
Text of the retry button.
Sample only: steps advance on a timer.
Sample only: autoplay interval in ms.
Show the sample order with Back / Advance buttons. Ignored once you pass steps.
The root element.

example:
<Timeline
  label="Account setup"
  steps={[
    { id: "account", title: "Create account", time: "09:12", status: "done" },
    { id: "team", title: "Invite your team", description: "Add at least one teammate.", status: "current" },
    { id: "billing", title: "Add billing", status: "upcoming" },
  ]}
  onStepClick={(step) => goTo(step.id)}
/>
